headline: Christian Brothers put four past Delta State
dek: Christian Brothers had lost three of their first four matches before scoring four times at Delta State, who had conceded five goals in their first five. Trevecca and UAH go into conference play unbeaten, having conceded three goals between them in seven matches.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's ten goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: Union's win at Christian Brothers is the first between two members this season, and Union's first win of any kind.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Five matches have passed their date with no result at all, the earliest Trevecca's at Belmont.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has conceded two goals for Trevecca and kept three clean sheets.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Christian Brothers have scored eight goals, and at least six different players have scored them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee are unbeaten, with three wins and two draws, and have conceded three goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Spring Hill have drawn one and lost one, and have scored one goal.

last_match.line: Christian Brothers had lost at home to Union in their previous match; Delta State had kept a clean sheet against Eckerd in theirs.

next_match.line: UAH have conceded once all season; West Alabama have yet to win.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
